requirements.title: Preserve refusal regressions
requirements.statement: A refactor MUST retain existing negative/security tests and MUST NOT weaken refused publication guarantees to obtain a passing demonstration.

requirements.title: Separate refactor from semantics
requirements.statement: Behavior-preserving decomposition MUST have equivalent normalized results before new behavior is enabled.

requirements.title: Thin instruction adapters
requirements.statement: Tool-specific instruction files MUST route to canonical policy/spec IDs rather than independently define setup law.

requirements.title: Tool capability declaration
requirements.statement: A worker MUST disclose missing execution or write capabilities before claiming implementation completion.

requirements.title: Do not overwrite instructions
requirements.statement: Applying this package MUST NOT replace existing root instructions or policies automatically.

requirements.title: Export is not admission
requirements.statement: AIDE exports MUST remain proposed with authorizes_implementation=false. Execution MAY proceed when a separate exact repository campaign binding or admitted queue record supplies authority; the export itself never does.

requirements.title: Pinned schema validation
requirements.statement: AIDE compatibility claims MUST name the exact schema identity and validation result.

requirements.title: AIDE optional build dependency
requirements.statement: Product building, tests and customer setup MUST remain executable without AIDE or model access.

requirements.title: Borrowed ownership
requirements.statement: Adapters retaining results beyond the next context call MUST copy into owned storage with explicit release.

requirements.title: Cancellation truth
requirements.statement: Cancellation APIs MUST distinguish request acceptance from terminal cancellation and preserve committed outcomes.

requirements.title: ABI evolution
requirements.statement: Public ABI changes MUST be additive within the supported major and validated against exported symbols, layouts and older consumers.

requirements.title: Reject dangerous paths
requirements.statement: Materialization MUST refuse traversal, absolute/device paths and target-equivalent collisions before creating payload objects.

requirements.title: Exact compressed boundaries
requirements.statement: Archive streaming MUST verify compressed boundaries, expanded length and required hashes/checksums before entry completion.

requirements.title: Metadata fidelity
requirements.statement: Unsupported mandatory native metadata MUST cause refusal or an explicitly authorized transformation, never silent loss.

requirements.title: No implicit activation
requirements.statement: Importing or validating this specification MUST NOT enable mutation, protected merges, signing or publication.

requirements.title: Single machine-contract owner
requirements.statement: Adopted runtime schemas MUST reside in contracts/; draft schemas in this archive MUST be promoted, not independently copied and evolved.

requirements.title: Independent evidence
requirements.statement: Specification validity MUST remain separate from runtime, security, accessibility and release qualification.

requirements.title: Deterministic bundle
requirements.statement: The same declared source, toolchain and profile inputs MUST produce the same specified unsigned bundle artifacts.

requirements.title: Adapter fidelity
requirements.statement: Package adapters MUST NOT change product selections, ownership, preservation or runtime requirements beyond the resolved graph.

requirements.title: No-code consumer
requirements.statement: The minimal authoring template MUST remain usable without copying or editing engine source.

requirements.title: Broker minimality
requirements.statement: The privileged broker MUST reject effects outside the exact plan and MUST ignore frontend-controlled plugins, themes and ambient search paths.

requirements.title: Safe post-install launch
requirements.statement: Post-install product launch MUST NOT unintentionally inherit setup elevation.

requirements.title: Bounded self-maintenance
requirements.statement: Self-repair/uninstall MUST execute from intact verified material outside the target being removed.

requirements.title: Separate bundle and plan
requirements.statement: A bundle MUST retain allowed deployment choices; a machine plan MUST bind the actual target, selections and observations.

requirements.title: Exact portable payload
requirements.statement: A setup envelope MUST carry the same finalized payload bytes as the selected portable release.

requirements.title: Bounded component solver
requirements.statement: Dependency resolution MUST detect cycles/conflicts and enforce declared computational limits.

requirements.title: Acquisition cannot install
requirements.statement: A source connector MUST NOT mutate installation roots or authoritative setup state.

requirements.title: Resume verifies final identity
requirements.statement: A resumed download MUST verify the complete final artifact identity before cache admission.

requirements.title: Offline self-sufficiency
requirements.statement: An offline profile MUST enumerate all required payload, trust and runtime dependencies before deployment.

requirements.title: No support Boolean
requirements.statement: Capability discovery MUST expose implementation, authority, qualification and support separately.

requirements.title: Deterministic selection
requirements.statement: Equal eligible provider candidates without an explicit tie-break policy MUST produce ambiguity refusal before effects.

requirements.title: Qualified guarantees
requirements.statement: An operation MUST refuse when any required guarantee is not supplied by the selected profile.

requirements.title: Machine mode never prompts
requirements.statement: Explicit machine/noninteractive invocation MUST never open UI or prompt, even when attached to a terminal.

requirements.title: Linear parity
requirements.statement: All admitted ordinary terminal workflows MUST remain operable in linear mode without color or cursor movement.

requirements.title: Terminal restoration
requirements.statement: TUI exits and cancellation MUST restore the owned terminal state and preserve operation truth.

requirements.title: Storage authority separation
requirements.statement: A DiskEd-like consumer setup path MUST have no general raw-device or filesystem-repair dispatch authority.

requirements.title: Eureka eligibility remains product-owned
requirements.statement: A discovered or cached artifact MUST NOT become eligible for installation solely because the consumer found it.

requirements.title: One installed-state authority
requirements.statement: Consumers MUST reference USK state/receipts rather than maintain competing installed-state truth.

requirements.title: No silent context truncation
requirements.statement: Context creation MUST refuse when required full task/authority content exceeds the selected byte budget.

requirements.title: Context binds inputs
requirements.statement: Every pack MUST contain exact selected file hashes and an explicit stale-input validation path.

requirements.title: Chat-only honesty
requirements.statement: A chat-only worker MUST distinguish review/proposed patch from executed implementation and tests.

requirements.title: Reliable detection
requirements.statement: Detection MUST distinguish healthy, damaged, partial, foreign-owned and absent states without mutation.

requirements.title: Prerequisite ownership
requirements.statement: Prerequisite servicing MUST respect shared/external ownership and declared removal policy.

requirements.title: No surprise reboot
requirements.statement: Setup MUST NOT reboot solely because a silent or vendor prerequisite path requests it.

requirements.title: Response-file parity
requirements.statement: GUI and unattended choices MUST use the same typed defaults, validation and constraints.

requirements.title: Fault every durable boundary
requirements.statement: Critical lifecycle implementations MUST be exercised with interruption at each declared durable transition.

requirements.title: Measured resource budgets
requirements.statement: Each supported profile MUST publish measured memory, disk and cancellation bounds for its declared corpus class.

requirements.title: Power-loss honesty
requirements.statement: Power-loss-qualified claims MUST require actual abrupt-power evidence on the named storage profile.

requirements.title: Keep live generations
requirements.statement: Generation reclamation MUST preserve generations referenced by active leases or unresolved operations.

requirements.title: Rollback compatibility
requirements.statement: Rollback MUST evaluate product-data compatibility separately from payload availability.

requirements.title: Immutable cache isolation
requirements.statement: Shared cached content MUST NOT be writable through an installed application path.

requirements.title: Accessible complete flows
requirements.statement: Every required native setup/maintenance flow MUST support keyboard and named assistive-technology operation on each supported target profile.

requirements.title: Safe theme fallback
requirements.statement: Malformed or incompatible branding MUST fall back to System Native without changing allowed effects.

requirements.title: Bootstrap independence
requirements.statement: Each setup profile MUST document and qualify its GUI/runtime dependency and preserve a recovery route when that runtime is missing.

requirements.title: Explicit provider loading
requirements.statement: Only explicitly configured and identity-verified providers MAY enter the runtime.

requirements.title: Provider lifetime
requirements.statement: A provider MUST remain alive while any operation/handle depends on it; unsupported unloading MUST refuse.

requirements.title: Extension authority ceiling
requirements.statement: An extension MUST NOT widen effective policy or create arbitrary effects.

requirements.title: Locator is not ownership
requirements.statement: No path, discovery record or product display name MAY establish installation ownership without an explicit installation identity and ownership record.

requirements.title: Lossless public numbers
requirements.statement: Public counts and offsets MUST round-trip without precision loss across supported clients.

requirements.title: Canonical hash profile
requirements.statement: Every digest-bound record MUST name its canonicalization and domain/version rules.

requirements.title: Unknown impact broadens
requirements.statement: Unclassified changes MUST select conservative review rather than an empty test list.

requirements.title: Cached evidence provenance
requirements.statement: Reused evidence MUST retain its original execution identity and explicit validity justification.

requirements.title: Reject stale worker
requirements.statement: After authority transfers, an earlier worker MUST be unable to commit under an obsolete lease/revision in a profile claiming automatic takeover.

requirements.title: Bound lock contention
requirements.statement: Lock acquisition MUST have a cancellation/deadline path and a structured conflicting-operation result.

requirements.title: State after locking
requirements.statement: A worker MUST revalidate expected installed state after acquiring the lease and before first effects.

requirements.title: Documentation impact
requirements.statement: A semantic implementation change MUST identify affected specification and publication pages or justify no documentation impact.

requirements.title: No fabricated freshness
requirements.statement: Generated current-state records MUST distinguish their input revision from the commit containing the generated record.

requirements.title: Unknown critical format
requirements.statement: Unknown critical state fields or record versions MUST block mutation while permitting safe retention/export.

requirements.title: Migration rollback truth
requirements.statement: A migration MUST declare inverse, backup restore, forward-only or operator-only recovery.

requirements.title: Migration atomic scope
requirements.statement: State migration MUST stage and validate outputs before replacing its declared authoritative records.

requirements.title: Dependency firewall
requirements.statement: The portable model and planner MUST NOT include platform GUI APIs or perform host mutation.

requirements.title: One effect owner
requirements.statement: Frontends and product bindings MUST route installed-software changes through the admitted USK operation interface.

requirements.title: No mandatory launcher
requirements.statement: Basic setup MUST remain usable without Universal Launcher or AIDE installed.

requirements.title: Stable logical identities
requirements.statement: Every normative concept and requirement MUST have a unique stable engineering ID independent of filename.

requirements.title: Preserve unknown metadata
requirements.statement: The knowledge reader MUST preserve unknown OKF fields and MUST NOT treat unknown concept types as executable instructions.

requirements.title: Correct provenance
requirements.statement: Source-derived claims MUST identify the source and its temporal scope; proposed extensions MUST be labelled as proposals.

requirements.title: Doctor is nonmutating
requirements.statement: Doctor MUST emit findings/remedy plans without directly applying them.

requirements.title: Idempotency conflict
requirements.statement: Reusing an idempotency key for different semantic input MUST refuse before effects.

requirements.title: Safe move
requirements.statement: Move MUST verify the new target and retain source material until the declared retirement guarantee is satisfied.

requirements.title: Preserve unknown content
requirements.statement: Repair and uninstall MUST preserve unknown or externally modified resources unless a separately reviewed plan explicitly owns that change.

requirements.title: Repair is not upgrade
requirements.statement: Repair MUST bind a specific release/generation and MUST NOT silently substitute the latest available package.

requirements.title: Native owner delegation
requirements.statement: USK MUST NOT directly alter payload owned by a native package manager.

requirements.title: Separate purge
requirements.statement: Uninstall MUST NOT imply deletion of product data, secrets or unrelated recovery records.

requirements.title: Effect closure
requirements.statement: Every externally visible setup effect MUST appear in the reviewed plan or be a specifically declared internal staging/journal effect.

requirements.title: No arbitrary hook
requirements.statement: Recipes MUST NOT admit unrestricted shell, downloaded-code or administrator hooks.

requirements.title: Independent verification
requirements.statement: Terminal success MUST require all critical effect verification obligations to succeed.

requirements.title: Native object ownership
requirements.statement: Native integration effects MUST verify the exact pre-state and current owner before replacing or deleting a resource.

requirements.title: Filesystem qualification
requirements.statement: Durability/publication guarantees MUST be qualified per named filesystem/profile, not inferred from OS family.

requirements.title: No cross-owner repair
requirements.statement: Native-package-managed payload MUST be serviced through its admitted owner adapter.

requirements.title: Narrowing composition
requirements.statement: Effective policy MUST NOT grant an operation denied by a higher safety or administrator constraint.

requirements.title: Unattended equivalence
requirements.statement: Unattended deployment MUST use the same planning, authorization and verification semantics as interactive deployment without unexpected UI.

requirements.title: No plan drift
requirements.statement: Execution MUST revalidate all declared material inputs and MUST NOT silently replace the reviewed effect set.

requirements.title: No build-only support claim
requirements.statement: A supported target claim MUST include required loader/runtime/behavior evidence, not merely a cross-compile.

requirements.title: Explicit platform floors
requirements.statement: Each binary release MUST declare and audit its OS/runtime/architecture/ISA floor and selected provider closure.

requirements.title: Reduced profiles retain semantics
requirements.statement: A reduced compatibility profile MUST preserve recognized data and refuse unavailable operations without pretending modern guarantees.

requirements.title: Delivery properties explicit
requirements.statement: Release manifests MUST separately state entrypoint count, physical-file closure, extraction behavior, runtime dependency and installation mode.

requirements.title: Customization cannot change law
requirements.statement: Data-only customization MUST NOT alter plan authorization, verification or recovery semantics.

requirements.title: No incompatible closure
requirements.statement: Unselected providers/frontends MUST be absent from the final binary dependency closure when their runtime raises the target floor.

requirements.title: Semantic frontend parity
requirements.statement: Every required ordinary setup journey MUST have equivalent normalized plans, effects and outcomes through the declared interfaces.

requirements.title: No UI authority
requirements.statement: Presentation MAY render only backend-admitted actions and MUST NOT implement installed-state effects.

requirements.title: Stale view handling
requirements.statement: An action against a stale relevant revision MUST refresh or refuse before effects.

requirements.title: Bind descendants through publish
requirements.statement: A publisher claiming protected staged-child authority MUST exclude or detect unauthorized substitution of every verified published descendant throughout its claimed protection interval.

requirements.title: Unmet publisher refuses
requirements.statement: Unavailable publication protection MUST remain an explicit no-effect refusal for profiles requiring it.

requirements.title: Publication evidence
requirements.statement: Publication receipts MUST bind the verified closure and actual visible target identity, including incomplete metadata disposition.

requirements.title: Read-only recovery inspection
requirements.statement: Recovery inspection MUST NOT mutate staging, targets, journals or ownership.

requirements.title: Idempotent recovery
requirements.statement: A recovery apply MUST bind original context and remain safe across repeated invocation and interruption.

requirements.title: Damaged binary recovery
requirements.statement: Each maintained profile MUST provide a recovery route independent of the executable being repaired.

requirements.title: Exact consumer locks
requirements.statement: A deployed consumer MUST bind provider source/tree, package version, artifact identity, ABI and contract set rather than a floating branch.

requirements.title: Immutable publication
requirements.statement: Published release tags and assets MUST NOT be replaced to hide defects.

requirements.title: Separate maturity
requirements.statement: Package/API version MUST NOT automatically set stable support or qualification.

requirements.title: Dependency-ordered work
requirements.statement: A task MUST NOT enter effectful implementation/qualification while a mandatory dependency, exact campaign task binding or required target/environment receipt is unresolved.

requirements.title: Consumer independence
requirements.statement: A consumer integration MUST retain product authority and ordinary portable operation independent of setup initialization where that is the product promise.

requirements.title: Installed SDK independent
requirements.statement: An installed SDK consumer MUST build without private headers, repository-local generators or AIDE.

requirements.title: Matched object sharing
requirements.statement: Build deduplication MUST preserve configuration-specific runtime, PIC, exports and instrumentation semantics.

requirements.title: Prepared source closure
requirements.statement: A source release MUST identify required build tools and generated inputs and avoid hidden developer-machine state.

requirements.title: Bound complete lifecycle memory
requirements.statement: Inspect, plan, install, verify, repair, move, update and recovery MUST obey aggregate memory budgets including old-tree inventories.

requirements.title: Correct short I/O
requirements.statement: Readers and writers MUST handle partial reads/writes and reject premature EOF or overflow before commit.

requirements.title: Bound concurrency
requirements.statement: Concurrent streams MUST reserve from one aggregate operation budget and release reservations on every terminal path.

requirements.title: Distribution closure
requirements.statement: Every distributed artifact MUST appear in one verified inventory with licences, dependencies and provenance references.

requirements.title: Signing isolation
requirements.statement: Production signing and publication credentials MUST be unavailable to untrusted PR jobs and ordinary spec tooling.

requirements.title: Reproducibility scope
requirements.statement: Reproducibility claims MUST state whether they cover unsigned payloads, final packages or signing transformations.

requirements.title: Requirement trace
requirements.statement: Every normative requirement MUST reference at least one acceptance definition with fixture, procedure, expected result, negative control and independent oracle.

requirements.title: Evidence exactness
requirements.statement: A result MUST bind exact material inputs and preserve failures and skips.

requirements.title: Human acceptance distinct
requirements.statement: Native usability and accessibility acceptance MUST not be synthesized from automated screenshots or tree checks alone.

requirements.title: Explicit adversary scope
requirements.statement: Security claims MUST identify excluded and included adversaries and actual OS enforcement mechanisms.

requirements.title: Untrusted descriptions
requirements.statement: Imported metadata, themes, logs and AI suggestions MUST NOT be interpreted as executable instructions or grants.

requirements.title: Security regression retention
requirements.statement: A fixed security defect MUST retain a bounded reproducible regression test and affected-profile description.

requirements.title: Separate integrity/authenticity
requirements.statement: Reports MUST distinguish checksum verification from publisher authentication.

requirements.title: Revocation enforced
requirements.statement: Revoked or policy-expired artifacts MUST NOT be silently re-admitted from local cache.

requirements.title: Downgrade distinction
requirements.statement: Authorized downgrade MUST retain trust checks and explicit data-compatibility analysis.

requirements.title: Truthful uncertain outcomes
requirements.statement: A disconnect or crash after dispatch MUST NOT be reported as no-effects failure without proof.

requirements.title: Durable effect ordering
requirements.statement: Every critical external effect MUST have durable prior intent and a distinguishable observed completion record.

requirements.title: No global atomicity claim
requirements.statement: A multi-resource operation MUST report partial completion when rollback cannot atomically restore all resources.

requirements.title: One-way mutation boundary
requirements.statement: ULK integration MUST NOT implement USK file/state mutation or require USK to understand product launch semantics.

requirements.title: Lease-aware setup
requirements.statement: When a profile permits updating beside active sessions, it MUST retain used generations until their leases are safely released.

requirements.title: No-fork tiny product
requirements.statement: A supported authoring profile MUST create a usable setup/maintenance product for a one-binary payload using only a declarative definition and optional assets.

requirements.title: Selective composition
requirements.statement: Consumers MUST be able to select contracts, authoring, inspect-only, embedded or prefab use without linking unrelated applications and providers.

requirements.title: Profile-specific claims
requirements.statement: Support MUST be expressed per operation and exact target profile, independently of implementation and permission.

requirements.title: Frame bounds
requirements.statement: A process host MUST reject oversized, truncated, malformed and duplicate-key frames before dispatch.

requirements.title: Reconnect identity
requirements.statement: Reconnect MUST inspect the original operation rather than infer no effects from a lost response.

requirements.title: No secret protocol leakage
requirements.statement: Machine responses and diagnostics MUST redact secret material while preserving safe correlation IDs.

requirements.title: Bound task authority
requirements.statement: Every nontrivial implementation task MUST bind scope, exact inputs, acceptance and an independently established execution authority. An active campaign record may supply standing authority; the task binding supplies exact source, scope, predecessors and environment without requiring a fresh owner ceremony.

requirements.title: Truthful completion
